title: Timeouts calling warehouse-api from inventory-service
symptoms: read/connect timeouts naming a downstream host
end-to-end latency dominated by waiting on a dependency
dependency health checks failing or degrading
elevated 5xx rate on the alerting service
observed_signals: downstream_latency_ms on the caller rose toward the configured client timeout
error rate rose after outbound calls started timing out
db utilization rose only where the caller held connections during the wait
timeout logs named a specific dependency, not the local database

timeline.event: synthetic checks to warehouse-api were still green
outbound p95 from inventory-service toward warehouse-api rose
circuit breaker or retry logs referenced warehouse-api
warehouse-api recovered or was isolated; caller errors receded

contributing_factors: warehouse-api was degraded in one region
inventory-service timeout was tight relative to the provider p99
resolution: confirmed warehouse-api latency on the provider status page and their dashboards
raised the client timeout only after proving the dependency was the bottleneck
enabled a circuit breaker and a cached fallback for non-critical reads
lessons_learned: distinguish caller CPU/memory (flat) from outbound latency (up)
fallback and circuit breaking should be tested, not only documented
